newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buderus sees results growing next year.
newsitem.headline: Buderus sees results growing next year.

text.p: German heating and appliance group Buderus AG said on Wednesday that it expects profits and sales to rise further in the 1996/1997 business year after the group posted a record profit in the 1995/1996 business year.
In the business year ending September 30, Buderus said pre-tax profits climbed nearly five percent to 220 million marks ($144.2 million) from 210 million marks in the previous business year.
Similarly, sales climbed six percent to 3.28 billion marks from 3.11 billion marks a year earlier.
Based on strong results Buderus said it will likely raise its dividend payout for the 1995/1996 business year from last year's 15 mark payout.
